candidate.source_a: Calcium phosphate forms crystalline deposits in bone tissue through osteoblast-mediated mineralization.
candidate.source_b: Marine diatoms precipitate silica-based cell walls using enzymatic silicatein proteins.

counterfactuals: Calcium phosphate forms crystalline deposits in bone tissue without enzyme involvement
Marine diatoms precipitate silica-based cell walls without enzymatic processes

evidence_assessment.notes: Source A shows osteoblast-mediated mineralization (enzyme involvement) for calcium phosphate deposition. Source B shows enzymatic silicatein proteins enabling silica precipitation. Neither source alone fully supports the specific concept of 'enzyme-templated mineral deposition' but together they provide complementary evidence.
